items.question: Is BookmarkForge really free?
items.answer: Yes! The free tier gives you 500 bookmarks, smart search, and all the basics — forever. No trial, no credit card, no catch. Upgrade to Pro only if you want unlimited bookmarks, sync across devices, or AI features.

items.question: Do I need to create an account?
items.answer: Nope! BookmarkForge works instantly in your browser. No sign-up, no email, no password. Just open the app and start saving.

items.question: What happens to my data if I stop using it?
items.answer: Your data stays on your device. You can export everything anytime to Markdown, JSON, CSV, or PDF. No lock-in, no hostage situations.

items.question: Is my data really private?
items.answer: Absolutely. Everything is encrypted on your device with a key only you have. We never see your bookmarks, notes, or passwords. Even we can't read your data.

items.question: What if I forget my password?
items.answer: When you first set up BookmarkForge, we show you a 24-word recovery phrase. Write it down and keep it safe. Without it, no one (including us) can access your vault.

items.question: Can I use it on my phone?
items.answer: Yes! BookmarkForge works on any device with a web browser. The free tier works on unlimited devices (each has its own vault). Pro syncs across up to 5 devices.

items.question: How do I import my bookmarks from Chrome/Firefox?
items.answer: Easy! Go to Settings → Import and choose your browser. BookmarkForge will automatically bring in all your bookmarks, folders, and tags.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We use Whop for payments: credit card, PayPal, and crypto. We never see your payment details. 30-day money-back guarantee — no questions asked.
